messages.content: 1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼?" They want the full name of England's king in 1800.

We need to use the tool `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` with location="England" or maybe "United Kingdom"? In 1800, King George III was on throne. Full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus? Wait that's later. Let's recall: George III reigned from 1760 until his death in 1820. His full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus? Actually I think it's George William Frederick Ernest Augustus; but I'm not sure if he had those names at birth. He was born as Prince George of Wales, son of Frederick, Duke of York and Albany. According to Wikipedia, his full name was George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. But some sources say his full name was George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. However, historically, his given names were George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. So we can answer accordingly.

But let's confirm via the tool. We'll call it.
